text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
When I'm staffing the check-out desk at
the
library, I get to see all sorts of
people, borrowing
all sorts of books—it's
so fun. ♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Like "Oh, I didn't know she was into
books like
this," and "Oh, then I bet
she'd like that book
too." My
imagination starts going wild!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I mean... I-I keep it to my
imagination! I'd
never dare tell anyone!
Who checked out what is
confidential
information!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, speaking of which... would you mind
keeping
what I just told you a secret?
